title: EvacuationShelter
description: Operational overlay for one evacuation shelter. The shelter master data (name, location) is not included; it is referenced by externalShelterId. Only opening status and evacuee counts live here.

project.description: The task subject's Project this entity belongs to, for example one disaster-response operation

externalShelterId.description: The shelter's ID in the municipality's 指定緊急避難場所一覧 (自治体標準オープンデータセット; unique within the municipality, e.g. CC0100022200). Together with localGovernmentCode it identifies the shelter nationwide

nationalShelterId.description: 全国共通避難所・避難場所ID (Cabinet Office SOBO-WEB / GSI 避難所等データ整備ウェブシステム): 14 characters, fixed 'E' + 5-digit municipality code + 5-digit facility code + type code (major '1' = designated shelter, the only value valid here; minor '1' = general shelter or '2' = welfare shelter) + 1 alphanumeric sequence starting at 1 (never 0). Optional: not every shelter has one assigned yet; omit the property entirely rather than send an empty string

localGovernmentCode.description: Local government code of the municipality that publishes the shelter list (全国地方公共団体コード, 6 digits)

openingStatus.description: Normalised opening state: open, closed, full (open but at capacity), requested (opening has been requested/instructed but is not yet confirmed open; no public code list defines this state, see statusLabel). The local wording always goes in statusLabel

statusLabel.description: The opening status as the headquarters names it (e.g. 未開設, 開設中, 満員, 依頼中). Use this whenever the local wording has no exact match in openingStatus's enum
